Name: Bani, Father of Imri
Summary: Father of Imri in the Jerusalem list, of the children of Pharez.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:4: Father of Imri in the Jerusalem list, of the children of Pharez.
LifeLesson: The mention of Bani in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
